messages:
Sam K: Heads-up: ops asked for clearer billing previews before we flip any v1->v2 routing. need a console flow that shows "estimated cost delta" + whether shadows counted vs billed.
Priya M: +1. important: previews must match token-model mapping we use for billing. otherwise tenants will be confused when their invoice arrives.
Carlos D: propose two lanes: preview (no quota impact, shows estimated tokens & cost) and live (moves traffic & affects quotas). previews are generated by replaying a day's sampled traffic through v2 cost model.
Evelyn H: replay sounds expensive. what about sampled simulation: 1% random sample across routes with weight scaling to estimate cost? add confidence interval.
Sam K: sampling ok if we surface CI. UX: show "Estimated delta: $X (+/- Y%)" and a little "confidence" bar. also show top 5 calls contributing to delta.
Priya M: telemetry naming: call it `deprecation.preview.estimated_cost` vs `deprecation.active.cost_delta`. keep preview metrics off billing pipelines.
Carlos D: routing policy detail: when tenant toggles "move to v2" we should support gradual weights: 0->100% over N minutes. need backend to accept `route.transition_minutes` and a `slope` param.
Evelyn H: nice. add ability to pause transition (ops escape hatch) and to revert to prior pinned version. record audit log entries for each change.
Sam K: question: do we count preview hits toward rate-limits or quota?
Priya M: no for preview. only for live. But provide "preview_quota_estimate" metric so tenants can plan.
Carlos D: alerting rules: if live p95 latency increases > 40ms above baseline or output-regression > 2% for 15m, auto pause the transition and notify owner + open incident.
Evelyn H: metrics: need these series: `deprecation.cohort.control_count`, `deprecation.cohort.preview_count`, `deprecation.cohort.live_count`, `deprecation.latency.delta_p95`, `deprecation.quality.regression_rate`.
Priya M: add tags: `route_id`, `tenant_id`, `deprecation_mode` (preview|gradual|live). and a boolean `preview_billed=false`.
Sam K: console details: add a small "cost preview" widget on route page with a toggle "Run preview" and a dropdown: sample rate (0.1% / 1% / 5%). clicking runs an adhoc job and returns results in ~20m.
Carlos D: backend plan: a job queue that replays sampled request records through the v2 inference pricing model and stores results in `deprecation_preview_results`. avoid replay for large tenants (>10M req/day) unless explicitly requested.
Evelyn H: UX copy for banner: "This route is eligible for v2. Preview estimated cost and quality before switching. Preview does not affect your quotas or billing." small "Run preview" CTA.
console-bot: NOTE: running a preview will create a temporary dashboard named "Preview - <route_id> - <ts>" with panels for cost, latency delta, and sample outputs (redacted).
alert-bot: ALERT RULES: if `deprecation.quality.regression_rate` > 3% for 30m during live rollout -> notify ops & route owner. if `deprecation.preview.estimated_cost` is > 50% over current -> add warning badge.
Sam K: security/PII: sample outputs must be scrubbed before storing. redact user_content and only keep hash+metadata for top prompts.
Priya M: good call. also add a privacy toggle for tenants to opt-out of preview storage.
Carlos D: API surface: PATCH /routes/{id}/deprecation {mode: preview|gradual|live, preview_sample: 1, transition_minutes: 60, slope: linear}. response includes `preview_job_id` when preview started.
Evelyn H: logging: every state change should emit an audit event `route.deprecation.change` with actor and before/after. and we should surface a small timeline in console route details.
Sam K: action items: Carlos -> design preview job infra + API. Priya -> finalize metric names & billing pipeline exclusions. Evelyn -> mock banner/modal copy + privacy options. Sam -> runbook for automated pause/revert and alerting thresholds.
Priya M: timeline: aim for alpha behind feature flag in 3 weeks. Carlos will spike infra this week.
Sam K: thanks all. I'll open the GH issues and link them here. :sparkles:
Carlos D: posted GH issue #4882 (preview job spike) — will add details.
Evelyn H: noted. will prepare mockups for Monday.
Sam K: end.
